answer: The anchor schedule is applied in violet and prism reveals each instalment. A payout is split so that 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2025 identities would post 3812 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
